connector.name: Invovate MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: AI-agent invoice generator: PDF, JSON & UBL in 11 languages via the Invovate API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package invovate-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lightspeedplusone account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: INVOVATE_API_KEY
env.description: Free Invovate API key (starts with inv_) from https://invovate.com/auth. Required only for the PDF/UBL tools; calculate_invoice_totals works without it.

env.name: INVOVATE_API_BASE
env.description: Override the API base URL (defaults to https://invovate.com).
